oracleRisk.summary: srUSDe is a senior ERC-4626 tranche over Strata's USDe strategy and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or token-level liquidation oracle. Junior capital absorbs first loss, while underlying USDe and sUSDe risks remain inherited dependencies.

branchApplicability.rationale: Strata's srUSDe is an ERC-4626 senior tranche whose Accounting component calculates tranche TVL and whose share-to-asset exchange rate determines deposits and redemptions; the senior NAV and yield path are therefore price-sensitive top-level valuation authorities. The reviewed srUSDe tranche has no borrower-owned debt or liquidation branches, so the disposition is top-level-only.
